primary_locator: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13528766/ (The Effects of Pitch Deepening on Audibility in Age-Related Hearing Loss, Koerber et al)
assessment: Thirty-one women recorded standard speech at baseline and in a deepened pitch. The Speech Intelligibility Index modeled audibility for age-related hearing loss. The tested speech-production manipulation provides no fresh lemon balm exposure or Parkinson speech treatment.

assessment: The reported dream enactment occurred during REM intrusion in a case of autoimmune encephalitis and sensory neuronopathy. It is a clinical description without a Swiss-chard dietary intervention or repeated exposure-related event count.

assessment: The presentation studies a brine-shrimp heat shock protein in relation to the organism's desiccation tolerance. This molecular outcome provides no dietary boiled-shrimp intervention or patient fall-frequency result.

assessment: The review assembles background evidence for evaluating RNAi-based genetically modified plants. Shrimp citations discuss molecular and immune responses in invertebrates, without a comparison of boiled-shrimp intake and human fall rates.

primary_locator: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7080017/ (8th EBSA presentation P-132, Abu Sharkh et al)
assessment: Brine shrimp are a background example of organisms tolerant to drying in an FTIR and calorimetry presentation. The experiments study trehalose and ions in model membranes and do not measure eating shrimp or falls.
